'''Riar''' was a major [[city]] located on the [[planet]] [[Toydaria]]. It had a population of approximately 100,000, of which about 80 percent were [[Toydarian]], and was divided into several districts. It was built on a series of hills.<ref name="GoD" />

The city was ruled by [[Baron]] [[Reeol]], whose line had ruled the city for nearly a [[Standard century|century]]. It was heavily involved in trade, especially with local regions, but also participated in larger trade networks.<ref name="GoD" />
